name: manage_persona
description: List available personas, inspect the current conversation persona, or switch the active conversation persona for future turns. Use this when the user asks to change operating mode/persona or when a different built-in persona is clearly better for subsequent work. Switching affects the next model turn; it does not rewrite the already-running prompt.

personaId.description: Persona id for switch, for example default, novelist, researcher, speaker, or editor.
